import statistics
vals=[3.5,3.4,3.5,3.3,3.3,3.7]
changes=[b-a for a,b in zip(vals, vals[1:])]
print(changes)

print('pop_sd', statistics.pstdev(changes))
print('half_sample', 1.28*statistics.stdev(changes))
PY"
